rules: P2 DECISION-AUTHORITY.md §3 A1-A9 with the §5 v0.2 changes C1-C5

decisions.statement: An invoice owes collection interest when today is more than 60 days after its due date (today > Due + 60 days) and something is still outstanding on it. The interest is 1% of the invoice amount (Amount only, not late fee), rounded to the cent half away from zero via Rules.round2. Implemented once, in Rules, citing DEC-B14.

"Still unpaid" in DEC-B14 is read as "something is still outstanding on the invoice" (outstanding > 0), the same reading the existing code already uses for "still unpaid" in DEC-B03 (Rules.isOverdue). Today no command records payments, so in practice every invoice past the threshold qualifies.

Collection interest is charged on every qualifying invoice regardless of the customer's kind: DEC-B14 and BILL-43-R1 ('every invoice that owes it') state no exclusion. The existing nonprofit exclusion (Rules.chased, used only by run-late-fees) has no decision record and is NOT extended to interest. Unresolved question for Credit Control: should nonprofit accounts be exempt from collection interest as they are from late fees? Any such exclusion needs an accepted decision before it is implemented.

Collection interest is independent of the late fee: an invoice owes it whether or not run-late-fees has been run on it, and it is computed on the invoice amount only. DEC-B14 sets no dependency on DEC-B03.

Add a field to Domain.Invoice recording the charged interest as an option (None = not yet charged, Some x = charged), initialised to None by issueInvoice. 'Once' is tracked by the option, not by a zero amount, because 1% of a very small invoice (e.g. 0.01) rounds to 0.00 and a zero sentinel would let it be charged (and counted) again on every run.
reasons: A2 'docs/architecture.md' does not resolve to a requirement, decision record or approval

decisions.statement: Rules.outstanding includes charged interest (Amount + LateFee + Interest - Paid), so balance (DEC-B02) includes it, as does the 'still unpaid' check.

'show is unchanged' is read as: the show command and its output format are not changed (no interest field is added to the line). Its 'outstanding' figure is computed by Rules.outstanding and therefore includes charged interest, as R1 requires interest to be part of what is outstanding on the invoice. Unresolved question for Credit Control: confirm that show's outstanding figure should include interest even though the line does not itemise it (the alternative reading - show's output byte-identical, outstanding excluding interest - would contradict R1's first statement).

Add Commands.runInterest (pure transition over invoices in issue order, output exactly 'interest charged: N') and dispatch 'run-interest' in Cli; add 'run-interest' to Cli.usage directly after 'run-late-fees', which also gives 'run-interest <extra words>' the existing 'error: usage: run-interest' response and leaves state unchanged.
reasons: A2 'docs/architecture.md' does not resolve to a requirement, decision record or approval

decisions.statement: Add 'run-interest' to the Commands list in README.md, after run-late-fees, so the documented command list matches help.

Add acceptance tests in tests/Billing.Tests/Acceptance/ for criteria the provided tests do not cover: show output format unchanged with outstanding including interest, interest on the amount only alongside a late fee, rounding half away from zero, once-only for a 0.00 interest, and the usage error for extra arguments.
